document: Private, source-faithful normalized T02 EF identity accounting candidate; not a repository report, timing result, or optimization decision.

normalization.scope: Per-capture registries; no identity references cross observer-process boundaries.
normalization.traceReference: Each requestTrace owns its traceId; traceRef in capture-level registries points to that requestTrace. Child command/save/event/generation-observation rows inherit the enclosing requestTrace traceId.
normalization.contextConnectionProviderReferences: contextRef, connectionRef, providerTypeRef, providerRef, transactionRef, and generationRef resolve only within one capture. Registry ordinal fields retain the original observer ordinal strings.
normalization.commandPairIdentity: commandOrdinal + executeMethod + occurrence inside the enclosing requestTrace; source, outcome, verb, token memberships, exact transaction join/scope comparison, and all reference-match booleans are retained.
normalization.terminalEndpointDefault: If terminalEndpointRef is omitted, it equals startEndpointRef. Otherwise it resolves to the distinct exact terminal endpoint; endpoint registry rows retain span ID, parent span ID, and closure kind.
normalization.nullableDefaults: Omitted command exceptionType and nullable transaction candidateCount, scopeComparison, providerRef, generationRef, transactionRef, contextRef, or connectionRef reconstruct as JSON null. A transaction contextRef/connectionRef value "sameAsCommand" reconstructs from the command pair context/connection references.
normalization.savePairIdentity: saveOrdinal inside the enclosing requestTrace; saveChangesPairs retain context, entitiesSavedCount, and start/terminal endpoint links.
normalization.transactionEventIdentity: Ordered transactionEventRows retain event suffix, transaction/provider/generation/context/connection references, lifecycle/transition, provider type reference, closure kind, and span reference. Missing nullable references reconstruct as null.
normalization.generationOrdering: generationObservations preserve the source array order per requestTrace; each points to a capture-local generation registry entry and retains that trace’s exact eventCounts and joined-command-pair count.
normalization.engineSpanIndex: engineSpans plus engineSpanOrder reconstruct the original capture-level engineSpanIndex exactly; traceId is inherited via traceRef. Span registry also carries event-only span IDs not present in that engine index.
normalization.roundTripReceipt: The generator reconstructed and exactly compared source commandPairs, SaveChanges pairRows, transaction event rows, transaction generation rows, and engineSpanIndex before writing. A follow-up provider-registry remap check confirmed each command/event/generation provider reference resolves to the original raw provider ordinal and the source inventory counts. The final v2 verification repeats all exact collection comparisons.
normalization.responseTimestampRelationMeaning: The copied responseFinishedUtc is the client HTTP IWR finally timestamp. Pair responseTimestampRelation values compare event observedUtc with that client timestamp only; no server request-finish or causal phase is implied.
normalization.saveChangesPairIdentity: SaveChangesStarting plus SaveChangesCompleted keyed by traceId, saveOrdinal, contextOrdinal, contextType. EF SaveChanges callback pairs and logger-observed savepoint event groups are distinct units; exact event-group-to-callback associations are unresolved.
normalization.sourceQualifierForSixAndFortyFour: The source-backed baseline ledger identifies six Coalesced HTTP and 44 Immediate HTTP savepoint event groups. Savepoint groups and EF SaveChanges callback pairs are distinct observed units; exact group-to-call association is unresolved.

captureMethod.EFcommandVsSQL: EF command callbacks are not SQL statement counts, rows, commits, or provider network round trips.
captureMethod.closureReconstruction: Follow each observer row span ID through the same-trace engineSpanIndex parentSpanId edges. Each row retains its direct span ID and closure class; the exported graph is stored once.
captureMethod.notEnlisted: EF callback observed DbCommand.Transaction null. This does not prove no ambient or server-side transaction.
captureMethod.oneEFCommandPair: one CommandExecuting plus one CommandExecuted keyed by traceId, commandOrdinal, executeMethod, occurrence
captureMethod.saveChangesPair: SaveChangesStarting plus SaveChangesCompleted keyed by traceId, saveOrdinal, contextOrdinal, contextType
captureMethod.tableToken: Allowlisted table-name membership extracted from redacted EF command shape. Multi-table commands make counts overlap.
captureMethod.timeComparison: observer observedUtc compared with the client HTTP IWR finally responseFinishedUtc timestamp; descriptive ordering only, not the server ASP.NET request-finished boundary and not a causal phase.
captureMethod.transactionGeneration: Exact observer tuple transactionOrdinal, providerTransactionOrdinal, generationOrdinal, connectionOrdinal, contextOrdinal; ordinal namespace is one observer process.

historicalAndCrossCaptureBoundaries: The two cadence captures ran in separate observer processes; do not join run-local HMAC/ordinal values across them.
The prior failed f6f58… capture is excluded. Included artifacts have wrapper exit 0, final/copy hash equality, self-check PASS, zero faults/overflow/open generations, and cleaned host/container.

Earlier retained packet/log census reported REST 102 Coalesced and 557 Immediate packets; the present EF command-pair counts are 101 and 556. The one-count difference is unreconciled and is not an optimization, gain, or causal repair. Keep the packet evidence separate.

The source-backed baseline ledger reports six Coalesced HTTP and 44 Immediate HTTP savepoint event groups. These are grouped logger observations, not EF SaveChanges callback pairs (41 and 158 respectively); exact event-group-to-callback associations remain unresolved.
TransactionStarted counts include mixed provider transactions, not PostgreSQL-only totals or checkpoint counts.
EF SaveChangesCompleted.entitiesSavedCount=0 is an EF field, not proof of no SQL; diagnostic SQLite EF command pairs were observed in both modes.
unresolved: No repository/provider method callsite is in EF command events; exact ancestry preserves only exported same-trace span parents and their actual attrs.
The unexported request Activity is recorded only as the exact parent shared by exported drain roots; no engine phase is assigned to its EF events.
No SQL text, statement cardinality, results/rows, provider wire round trips, or server transaction outcome is proven.
No exact transaction participant registry or SaveChanges-to-provider-transaction association is exposed by these EF event rows.
Outbox table-token presence and span closure do not show row identity, claim/delivery lifecycle, or a repository caller join. No diagnostics DB was read.
HTTP harness metadata says output matched but HTTP detail export contains no output values; REST detail lists referenceText. Output values and workflow inputs are omitted.

No timing/latency comparison, causal background attribution, or optimization claim is made. Low-logging timing baselines and root integration remain unfinished T02 work; independent capture QA is accepted.
